title: Odd-level tail formula
statement: If $k$ is an odd natural number, then the limiting majority Fourier weight above $k$ equals $\sum_{r=0}^{\infty} w_{k+2(r+1)}$, where $w_j$ is the limiting majority Fourier weight at level $j$.
